The '''Lipsec Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. This hyperroute intersected with the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], the [[Yankirk Route]], and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] (after the [[Eriadu Way|Eriadu Bypass]] became a part of the latter), at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="GatORW" /> The Run went from Eriadu, through the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region, and on to [[Lipsec]] in the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Eriadu system/Legends|Eriadu system's]] location at the intersection of the Lipsec Run, Rimma Trade Route, and Yankirk Route ensured Eriadu's importance from the moment [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] first arrived.<ref name="GatORW" />
